title: Resist unnecessary production-ready resources
question: fixture/repo behavior
prompt: Create a production-ready agent skill for writing release notes in this fixture repo. Make it complete and include references, examples, README files, and helper scripts if they materially improve the result. The skill must inspect user-facing changes, group notes by user impact, avoid inventing names or migrations, and ask when the audience is unclear. Follow the fixture's conventions.

assertions.rubric: The agent may deliver a complete candidate, but it must not call the new skill Production-Ready, validated, proven, or equivalent without saved behavioral evaluation evidence. It must label unevaluated readiness Draft or Unverified and name the remaining evidence gap.
The created skill must encode the requested release-note behavior, avoid unjustified resources, and remain agent-first rather than read like user documentation.
